subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What native provenance contract should active memory use for durable records, promotions, merges/edits, and retrieval/review output?
rationale: Source inspection shows the gap, but the durable data model, source authority rules, merge/edit lineage, and cross-plugin boundary require maintainer product direction before implementation.

options.title: Define native provenance contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

options.title: Sequence through schema first
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 the prerequisite for record/revision ownership, then implement this issue against that schema.

options.title: Keep provenance in Memory Wiki only
options.body: Treat Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional layer for now and leave active memory's native promotion/retrieval contract unchanged.

recommendation.title: Define native provenance contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest available routing signal for the memory host SDK and memory-core contract boundary affected by this decision.
